QuestInfo.name: Cakes or Pies?
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator needs help settling an argument between Cake Boss Daniel and Pie Lord Tiara. It's gotten quite out of hand.
QuestInfo.1: You have to help the Pie/Cake faction win their status as this year's MapleStory Anniversary official dessert! Go see Pie Lord Tiara/Cake Boss Daniel.
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator needs help settling an argument between Cake Boss Daniel and Pie Lord Tiara.

0.0: Oh my! Oh no! Things have totally spiraled out of control! You see, Cake Boss Daniel and Pie Lord Tiara have never gotten along. But I never imagined things would spiral so out of control!

yes.0: I'll let you know your side.

no.0: No dessert for you then. Oh, come on. It'll be fun! You can win some awesome prizes, too!
